display_name: 短线王 · A 股短线复盘工作台
description_zh: 从盘中盯盘到收盘复盘，再到用游资案例练习判断，短线王把 A 股短线研究放进一个本地工作台。看竞价强弱、题材轮动和连板梯队，把比赛选手公开披露的交易放回当天的盘面。选一个游资历史案例，遮住结局先写自己的判断，再揭晓、看反例。研究个股时，让 AI 对照同一份资料展开多空辩论。想检验一种思路，可以跑历史回测，也可以今晚记下条件、明天收盘对账。自己的成交和盈亏记在本机交易日志里。
description_en: Read the A-share market live, review the close, and practice your judgment on historical trades. Askill puts auction strength, theme rotation, and limit-up streaks alongside contest traders’ public disclosures. Work through a trader case before revealing the outcome, then compare counterexamples. Have AI weigh the bull and bear cases for a stock using the same evidence. Test an idea against history or record it tonight and check it at tomorrow’s close. Your personal trade journal stays on your computer.
author: Barryyangdong
examples_zh: 帮我安装短线王并接入 WorkBuddy，验证一次对话，带我打开最近一个交易日的收盘复盘。
打开短线王的「游资蒸馏」，带我找到历史盲练。我想先看当时的盘面，写下判断后再揭晓结果。
打开我已有的短线王，带我找到个股研究的多空辩论入口。我想看看同一份资料分别支持哪些判断。
examples_en: Install Askill, connect WorkBuddy, verify a reply, and open the latest trading day’s closing review.
Open the historical case practice in Askill. I want to study the market at the time and record my judgment before revealing the outcome.
Open my existing Askill workspace and show me where to start a bull-and-bear debate on an A-share stock using the same evidence.
